content.title: Where to watch #1 Duke vs. #5 St. John’s Sweet 16 game tonight on free streams, TV
content.text: Updated: Mar. 27, 2026, 3:45 p.m.Published: Mar. 27, 2026, 3:45 p.m.GREENVILLE, SOUTH CAROLINA - MARCH 21: Cameron Boozer #12 of the Duke Blue Devils goes up for a shot uring the second round of the 2026 NCAA Men's Basketball Tournament held at Bon Secours Wellness Arena on March 21, 2026 in Greenville, South Carolina. (Photo by Jamie Sabau/NCAA Photos via Getty Images)NCAA Photos via Getty ImagesIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Dustin Hockensmith | dhockensmith@pennlive.comThe top-seeded Duke Blue Devils continue their run in the East Regional of the NCAA Men’s Basketball Tournament with a Friday night Sweet 16 game against the No. 5 St. John’s Red Storm. The game is scheduled to start at 7:10 p.m. ET with TV coverage on CBS and streaming on-demand.How to watch #1 Duke vs. #5 St. John’s on TV and stream without cable:Start time: 7:10 p.m. ETWhere: Capital One Bank Arena, Washington, D.C.TV channel: CBS and Paramount+Streaming on: FuboTV (free trial) | DirecTV (free trial) | Paramount+ (free trial)#1 Duke vs. #5 St. John’s: The matchupCameron Boozer and the Blue Devils are 6.5-point favorites in Friday’s matchup with the Johnnies, who last played a Sweet 16 game in 1998-’99 under former coach Mike Jarvis. Meanwhile, the Blue Devils have been tested from the jump in their current tournament run as one of college basketball’s most dominant programs, with coach Jon Scheyer and company looking for their first national title in 11 years. Duke had to overcome a shaky start and halftime deficit in its opener against No. 16 Siena, narrowly avoiding an upset with a 71-65 victory. The performance was more crisp in dispatching No. 9 TCU (81-58) behind an offense that knocked down 55% of its field goals and a defense that held TCU to just 33% shooting. St. John’s is a 30-6 team that won the Big East championship with its second win over UConn, then beat No. 12 Northern Iowa (79-53) and No. 4 Kansas (67-65) on a Round 2 buzzer-beating layup by Dylan Darling that was the only basket he made in the game.#1 Duke vs. #5 St. John’s: Know your live streamsFuboTV (free trial): FuboTV offers the most extensive package of live sports with rates competitive with DirecTV.
